object: electronics, repair and robotics historical handover convergence
delta: Recovered direct lineage from a November 2024 Android-robotics comparison through its November 2025 role/bus reframing to the later phone-to-USB-CDC-to-MCU cassette pattern; the mature architecture is not backdated to 2024.

Separated specification from embodiment for PhoneCassette and the One-Axis Motion Platform: detailed diagrams, BOMs, interfaces and loggers are SPEC evidence, not proof of a fabricated or tested machine.

Retained the lowest-regret device allocation: old Android phones take fixed-camera, rover-brain, microphone/display and disposable-field roles first; current high-capability phones remain flexible compute/control/lab nodes.

Promoted two repair invariants: exact model/revision must match service instructions before model-specific action; energized or heat-producing machinery is observation-only, with chemical treatment performed only de-energized and component-compatible.
Unified hardware proof state as SPECIFIED != BUILT != TESTED != ADOPTED and preserved unresolved build/test gaps instead of laundering them into current capability.
Held the alleged older portable-gearing ancestor outside canon because the strongest recovered pre-chat evidence lacks eligible conversation provenance.

private_source_class: retained generated artifacts with creation metadata
evidence.not_committed: Raw private conversation text, personal incident detail and external account material remain outside the public repository.

value: Future workers can distinguish historical architecture lineage from later refinement without false backdating.
Hardware proposals cannot become machine-state claims without physical receipts.
Repair guidance now fails closed on identity mismatch and energized chemical intervention.
Device allocation preserves scarce mobile capability while reusing older hardware for bounded roles.
The return reduces repeated re-derivation without creating another runtime, dashboard, authority store or project.
authority: Explicit user request on 2026-09-30 to keep the convergence empirical, visible in the repository and folded into existing FIELD discipline.
residue: Original conversation title for the July 13, 2026 One-Axis Motion Platform artifact remains unavailable; Convergence Foundry is the nearest recoverable project context.
Earliest conversation title for the 2026 Pixel allocation decision remains unresolved even though the decision is strongly attested by August-September artifacts.
No hard physical build proof has been recovered for PhoneCassette, the old-phone rover, the One-Axis platform or the earlier radial electronics proposal.
The pre-chat portable-gearing ancestor remains external evidence only until eligible conversation provenance appears.
next: Promote nothing further until a physical receipt closes one of the unresolved build/test gaps or new source evidence resolves provenance.
stop: No new hardware route, dashboard, state store, architecture layer or authority surface.
summary: Historical work existed across phone robotics, repair practice, modular motion and device-role allocation, but proof state and provenance were easy to blur across repeated summaries.
